content:
alex: Quick heads up — finalizing release notes for v2.8.0. Target deploy tonight 23:00 UTC. Need internal announce copy, pin window, and rollback thresholds. Pinged ops for calendar.
priya: Draft internal announce below — can someone confirm infra bits?
priya: ```Internal (internal-only): Deploying v2.8.0 tonight 23:00 UTC. Highlights: improved batching, KV cache persistence, lower per-token cost. Canary 5% for 15m, then 25% for 30m, then full. Rollback if errors >3% or avg p95 latency +200ms.```
marc: +1 on the copy. Suggest add: automatic fallback to v2.7 pinned and explicit model pin (rwdl-7b-q4f -> release-2.8.0-stable).
jamie: Ops: Calendar OK. I can put the maintenance banner at 22:30 UTC. Are there any DB migrations?
alex: No schema migrations — just config/pinning + rollout.
lina: Docs: I'll update the release notes page and add a short changelog. Priya's copy looks good; I'll trim to a single para for internal.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by alex · v2.8.0 -> canary 5% @ 2024-12-15 23:00 UTC (1913456789)
marc: Rollback plan: manual rollback button -> immediate revert to release-2.7.3 pinned. If canary shows error spike, ops to hit rollback. Runbook link added.
priya: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/release-rollback
alex: For release notes include these bullets:
alex: ```- Improved continuous batching heuristics (avg token/sec +12%)
- KV cache persistence across warm restarts
- Default quantization profile updated: q4f-opt
- Bugfix: correct padding handling in tokenizer```
lina: I'll add those and include a line: "SLOs unaffected for standard workloads."
jamie: Ops alert thresholds: 5xxs > 3% over 10m OR p95 latency +200ms across 1m -> escalate to on-call and disable canary.
marc: Also set rate-limiter to prevent canary from overloading downstream services.
priya: Internal announce short copy ready: "Deploying v2.8.0 tonight 23:00 UTC. Canary first, rollback to v2.7.3 if issues. See runbook." Post to #general at 23:05 after canary stable?
alex: Yes — post at 23:05 after canary stable. Also pin release notes page in console and notify QA.
lina: Scheduling internal post and pin now. Do we need localized internal messages?
priya: Not for internal. Marketing will handle localized public notes tomorrow.
marc: Last config check: ensure model pin tag present: `model_tag: rwdl-7b-q4f:release-2.8.0` — infra confirm?
jamie: Infra confirms config present in staging and canary; pushed to prod config repo.
alex: Great. I'll post a final pre-deploy update in 30m. :thumbsup:
lina: :rocket:
deploy-bot: Rollout started: v2.8.0 canary 5% @ 23:00 UTC — job id dpl-20241215-01
priya: We'll monitor evals dashboard and sample outputs for regressions and surface any quality issues immediately.
alex: If anything looks off, call for rollback ASAP. End."
